products.name: Vitamin PDRN Bouncy Pore Serum
products.description: Vitamin PDRN Bouncy Pore Serum is a vegan, skin-fortifying serum for visible pores, loss of bounce, and tired-looking texture. The 35 mL formula is powered by 3 types of Vegan PDRN derived from rice, ginseng, and lactobacillus, never salmon or fish, alongside a peptide complex and 5 types of Vitamin C. It is designed to refine the look of pores, support visible elasticity, strengthen the moisture barrier, and leave skin looking smoother and bouncier without a heavy finish.
products.mode_emploi: Use it after cleansing and toner, then follow with moisturizer.
